description: Deliberately wrong candidate: CONCAT ignores NULL in DuckDB while || propagates NULL
Test multiple rows including NULL values
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE employees(first_name VARCHAR, last_name VARCHAR)
expected_sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name FROM employees ORDER BY first_name NULLS LAST
candidate_sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name FROM employees ORDER BY first_name NULLS LAST

description: Deliberately wrong candidate on NULL rows
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE employees(first_name VARCHAR, last_name VARCHAR)
expected_sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name FROM employees ORDER BY first_name NULLS LAST
candidate_sql: SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS full_name FROM employees ORDER BY first_name NULLS LAST
